authority_scope: Current governed AOM hierarchy, schema, and material assertions
use_for: Complete closure, impact counts, compatibility surface, and current modelling intent
do_not_use_for: Independent biological, chemical, regulatory, or agricultural truth
cohort_conclusion: Use as audited baseline; every recommendation must identify affected assertions and downstream migration.

authority_scope: Food products, materials, origins, processing, and components across human and domesticated-animal food
use_for: Independent facets, reuse of external anatomy/chemistry ontologies, and open-world handling of unknowns
do_not_use_for: Exact copying of inherited LanguaL branches or feed-specific product regulation
cohort_conclusion: Keep source, component, process, chemical identity, and product use independent; do not create Other anatomy catch-all.

authority_scope: Chemical entities, molecular entities, substances, roles, and structures
use_for: Boundary between chemical identity and composition measurement; external mapping target
do_not_use_for: Feed-material classification, additive authorization, or measured content
cohort_conclusion: Keep AOM chemical identity separate from Feed Chemical Composition and from feed-product kind.

authority_scope: Cross-species plant anatomy, morphology, and development
use_for: Exact or close mapping of true plant anatomical components
do_not_use_for: Commercial milling fractions, crop residues, or process-defined feed products
cohort_conclusion: Endosperm remains anatomy; germ requires embryo-versus-fraction split; Bran is not forced into anatomy.

use_for: Animal anatomical subgroup and mappings for Liver and Viscera review
do_not_use_for: Animal body substances such as blood or economic by-product roles
cohort_conclusion: Add Plant and Animal anatomical navigation only; keep body substances and product roles separate.

authority_scope: Legally described feed materials and manufacturing products
use_for: Feed-material identity, manufacturing provenance, and composition of named maize fractions
cohort_conclusion: Treat Bran and commercial Germ as process-defined feed materials/fractions, not exact anatomical structures.

authority_scope: Agricultural terminology for residues, products, and uses
use_for: Crop-residue status of Straw and Stover
do_not_use_for: Formal identity axioms or exact feed hierarchy
cohort_conclusion: Move Straw and Stover out of material-component vocabulary; represent them as crop-residue material identities plus role and source facets.
